description.value: Roadrunner Restaurant is a classic greasy-spoon diner in Langley Township with a country-town aesthetic, serving a full brunch menu of Eggs Bennys, omelettes, sandwiches, and burgers. Both dine-in and takeout are offered, and customer reviews consistently highlight friendly staff and well-cooked food. It sits on 62 Avenue and makes a practical and welcoming refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the area.

OSM corroborates the diner category and notes outdoor_seating=yes, toilets=customer, and internet_access=wlan, but none of these amenity tags are confirmed by the website. Bike parking is not mentioned in either source.
